keywords.if:
Conditional block. Body renders when `<expr>` is truthy.

Inside an array or object literal it stands in for items, contributing the ones its taken branch holds.
keywords.foreach:
Iterate `<array>`, binding each element to `<name>` in a temporary scope.

Inside an array or object literal it stands in for items, contributing one per iteration.
keywords.in: Separates the loop binding from the iterable.
keywords.break: Immediately break out of the innermost `foreach`.
keywords.continue: Skip to the next iteration of the innermost `foreach`.
keywords.return: End evaluation immediately and return the value of `<expr>`.
keywords.stop: End evaluation immediately, keeping the text rendered so far.

namespaceDoc: A state namespace this document uses.
holds: Holds {list}{more, select, true {, and more} other {}}.
triggerDoc: Render another entry's text in place.
resolvesTo: Resolves to `{value}` for the loaded context.
noValue: No loaded value for this variable in the current context.
writtenByCommand: Written by a command in this body.
